fresh_player_report.source: Separate gpt-6.1-sol max session; normal browser UI only; no design/source access.
fresh_player_report.goal_understood: Find the continuing leak in each of two tubes and make flat patches.
fresh_player_report.actions: Compared region observations; guided middle leak; independent middle bubbles cleared, right clear, left returned. Marked, glued, waited twice, pressed and tested. Both first tests succeeded.
fresh_player_report.ending_and_restart: Reached the ending and restarted; initial screen visibly restored.
fresh_player_report.feedback: Changing observation text and preparation readiness made the next action clear. No blocking usability issue.
fresh_player_report.minor_note: Mark becomes available after one observation although instructions recommend comparing two. This is allowed by the design; clarify the recommendation rather than silently changing the rule.

root_visual_review.observations: The whitebox is clear but resembles a form: three tube-region cards, a rectangular biscuit-tin label, and long helper paragraphs. The 1440-wide workspace is about 1200 pixels tall.
production_priorities: Give the basin, inner tube and blue biscuit tin a coherent original illustrated workbench identity.
Prioritise the current action and keep result feedback near the tools, with a compact desktop layout and readable phone reflow.
Keep factual framing concise. Technical provenance and repeated adaptation-policy explanations belong in documents; retain the fictional/game-practice label and uncertainty where relevant.
Preserve tested causal rules, selectors, full text access and focus behaviour.

qa_plan_correction.reason: Host source data uses the supplied timeline titles; generated replay expected a generic chapter number.

scope_review: Keep two game-only repair exercises and all ten unchanged memories. No extra systems, photos, voice or network services. Main-path play time and subjective enjoyment are unmeasured.
